answer: Locate agents by the speed of light. At dawn each epoch, five randomly chosen verifiers on different continents send an agent a timed nonce and record the round-trip delays. Physics can't be faked downward: a reply from Ohio can't reach Tokyo in 20 ms. A farm of 500 names on one rack triangulates to the same hollow on the map, like water pooling in a single karst sinkhole, so those identities share one reward slot instead of 500.
